findings.title: Converted monitor config is discarded in occurrence context
findings.body: get_monitor_environment_context copies monitor.config into `config` and replaces config['schedule_type'] with get_schedule_type_display(), but the returned context uses monitor_environment.monitor.config instead of the converted `config`. The conversion is therefore dead code and occurrences will contain the raw schedule_type value rather than the intended display value.
